results.rationale: Consistency: Excluding column removal and associated spacing, the white background and receding column motif remain, but the retained columns have noticeably remodeled, lumpier capitals and altered shaft/base proportions and darker outlines. Instruction: The original eight columns become six (one isolated at left and five at right); the expected result is exactly five. The count is reduced but the required count is wrong, giving partial compliance. Quality: Structure and lighting are broadly coherent, but wavy, crumpled capital details and irregular base contours are clear geometric artifacts; surface shading is otherwise readable.

Consistency: The white background, saucers and right cup position remain recognizable. Beyond the permitted left-cup resizing, the right coffee beans acquire conspicuous colored outlines and altered gloss, while the left bean arrangement is replaced and the cup opening becomes markedly oval. Instruction: The left cup becomes a taller oval, but remains substantially narrower and smaller than the right cup. A correct result would enlarge it to the large cup’s dimensions; most of that size change is missing. Quality: Cup and saucer structure and shadow direction are coherent, but the right beans have unnatural rainbow-like edge halos and the left cup contains conspicuous white fragments among the beans. These are noticeable texture/semantic artifacts.
